subject: Quarter Launch: Ownership Roster, Risk Runway, and Final Sign-off
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: katie@execcoach.io
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter Launch: Ownership Roster, Risk Runway, and Final Sign-off

Team —

We need final sign-off for the Q2 launch playbook and the OKR owner roster by EOD Friday so we can lock the QBR materials. Key asks below: 

1) Owners: see the table in the attached Q2_OKR_Roadmap.xlsx. Please confirm owners for each objective where your name is listed, or nominate an alternate.

2) Risk runway: attached is the initial risk heatmap. Marcus, I flagged a capacity risk under "Serving Runtime" with an expected impact to latency SLOs if we exceed forecasted token/hour growth. Can you review and add mitigation owners?

3) Onboarding/readout: Katie (copied) will run a 20-minute rehearsal for the QBR deck next Wed. We need two canary metrics agreed (latency p50 and per-token cost) and who will own the readout.

Decisions requested: owners confirmed, mitigation owner for the capacity item, and sign-off on the playbook sections by 2027-04-23 17:00 PT. If you cannot meet that deadline indicate when you can.

Attachments: [Attachment: Q2_OKR_Roadmap.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 128KB)], [Attachment: risk-heatmap.png (image/png, 210KB)]

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Launch: Ownership Roster, Risk Runway, and Final Sign-off

Thanks Priya — quick confirmations: 

- I confirm ownership for Platform Latency objective (owner listed in sheet).
- I'll shift two backend sprints from infra backlog into the Q2 runway; estimate this buys ~3 weeks of runway against the capacity risk.
- For canary metrics: I'll volunteer to own latency p50; Marcus can own per-token cost if that works.

I'll upload a short gantt into the same folder by EOD.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Launch: Ownership Roster, Risk Runway, and Final Sign-off

+1 to Aditya's shift — that helps. Quick notes after reviewing the heatmap: 

- Capacity risk "Serving Runtime" (High likelihood / High impact). Root cause: predicted 40% QoQ token growth paired with two commercial pilots that may spike sustained concurrency.
- Immediate mitigations: enable prefix KV cache for the pilot accounts; enable 8-bit quantization for internal test variants; schedule a dedicated 4-GPU burst pool for the first 10 business days of the pilot (cost estimate attached).

Attachment: [Attachment: capacity-runway.csv (text/csv, 24KB)]

Question for leadership: are we comfortable approving the temporary burst pool budget (estimated incremental $27K for a 10-day window)? If not, we need go/no-go criteria for throttling pilots.

On canary metrics: I can own per-token cost, and I will produce a short dashboard widget for the console that Katie can reference during the rehearsal.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Capacity & Performance
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Launch: Ownership Roster, Risk Runway, and Final Sign-off

Thanks — good work surfacing the risk and mitigations. A few decisions from my side: 

- Approve the burst pool budget requested ($27K for the 10-day window) as a one-time contingency for pilots. We will track ROI in the QBR and revert if it is not justified.
- Owners as listed are OK with two small asks: Aditya, please include a short contingency slide (2 bullets) on sprint trade-offs; Marcus, add expected delta to per-token cost under the burst scenario.
- Katie, please schedule the rehearsal for 2027-04-28 at 10:00 PT and confirm dial-in.

I will sign off on the playbook once the contingency slide and cost delta are attached.

Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Launch: Ownership Roster, Risk Runway, and Final Sign-off

Team — thank you. Summary & next steps: 

- Owners: confirmed (Aditya / Marcus / others in sheet).
- Budget: Laura approved the burst pool contingency ($27K). Finance will create a spend tag; Marcus to confirm final cost delta and add to the playbook.
- Deliverables due: contingency slide + cost delta (Marcus), gantt update (Aditya), rehearsal invite (Katie). All due by 2027-04-27 COB so we can lock the QBR packet.
- Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1Q-example-Q2-launch-playbook (playbook folder), HUBSPOT-RECORD-678912 (pilot record).

Once the three deliverables are in the folder I will mark the playbook "Signed" and archive the thread.

Thanks —
Priya
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
